# AcademyPro

> The only academy management platform built specifically for pickleball and padel — combining franchise-grade operations, unified curriculum delivery, and a player-facing training app into one system, from a single coach to a multi-city network.

AcademyPro solves the core problem every growing racket-sport academy faces: quality degrades as you scale. When a second coach joins, students get a different experience. When a third location opens, the founder loses visibility. AcademyPro fixes this by treating a coaching business like a franchise — one standardized program, delivered consistently by every coach, tracked across every student, visible to the academy owner at all times.

## What makes AcademyPro unique

AcademyPro is the only platform in the world purpose-built for pickleball and padel academy management. Generic studio software (Mindbody, Pike13, TeamUp) handles bookings but has no concept of skill progression, DUPR ratings, or sport-specific curriculum structure. AcademyPro is built around the sport from the ground up:

- **DUPR integration** — student ratings sync with the official DUPR rating system, so programs are matched to real skill levels (2.0 through 5.0+), not arbitrary tiers an admin invents
- **Unified curriculum engine** — the academy owner builds the program once: drills, progressions, assessments, skill benchmarks. Every coach on the network teaches from the same playbook, automatically
- **Franchise-grade consistency** — whether a student trains with Coach A in one city or Coach B in another, they receive the same curriculum, the same standards, the same progression path. Quality is structural, not personal
- **Network visibility** — the academy owner sees every coach's performance, every student's progress, and every result across the whole network in real time, without chasing spreadsheets
- **White-label platform** — academies can brand the entire product as their own. Students see your academy's name, not AcademyPro
- **Built-in player app** — students don't need a separate tool. The same platform gives players a logbook, a rating-matched training program, and a doubles game tracker, all synced with their coach's program
- **Revenue flexibility** — pricing starts at $99/mo for a solo coach and scales to a revenue-share model for large multi-location academies. Coaches can manage their own memberships, pricing, and payouts within the academy's structure
- **Integrations that matter for this sport** — Stripe (billing and subscriptions), DUPR (official ratings), Court Reserve, and OpenCourt. No workarounds for the bookings and payments infrastructure coaches already use

## Who it is for

AcademyPro serves two connected audiences on the same platform:

**Academy owners and coaches** — solo coaches who want structure, growing academies standardizing across 2–10 coaches, and multi-city networks that need franchise-level consistency without franchise-level overhead. The platform replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and patchworked tools with a single system.

**Players** — anyone playing pickleball or padel from beginner through competitive level. Players get a rating-matched program designed by certified coaches, a permanent session logbook, drill tracking, and a live doubles game scorer.

## Pricing

- Coach: $99/month — solo coach, full platform access
- Academy Starter: $399/month — multi-coach management, unified curriculum, progress tracking
- Growth: $699/month — full white-label, all integrations (Stripe, DUPR, Court Reserve, OpenCourt)
- Scale: revenue share — multi-city networks and enterprise academies
